name: bom_counts_the_components
why: ENTRY GT9. The standard delivery of an assembly is the drawing with the BOM and the ballooning (the balloons with the item numbers). A 120x80x10 base and a 120x80x4 cover resting on top (not inside: y = 7), drawing of the assembly, BOM and balloons.
defect_caught: The BOM that counts the components differently from the assembly (wrong type: «parts only» instead of «top level», an enum that starts from 1), the quantity that does not add up the parts, and the balloons that are not born or are born in a number different from the items.

expect.why: the view attaches to the FILE of the assembly
the table and the assembly, each read on its own
measured and put in a free place
one per component, counted afterwards on the view
the item numbers of the BOM
every item of the BOM has its balloon: on the Starlink assembly (26/9/2026) the disc, covered in the isometric view, was left without one and the answer said «done»
